verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly suggests portability. LangGraph's core handles scheduling, checkpointing and state. Community reports say nodes are just arbitrary functions and that LangChain abstractions are optional, so the graph itself is not tied to any one LLM. Swapping models would therefore mean changing node code rather than the graph, but no evidence shows a documented provider-agnostic model interface or a config-level model swap. Missing for 10: documented provider-agnostic chat-model interface, examples of swapping providers or models without code changes, a list of supported providers, and hands-on corroboration of portability.
